value: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94 of 16 April 1997 "On Housing Relations" (art. 24: letting of private housing where the owner does not live), with the Civil Code lease chapters.
source_publisher: Adilet legal information system (Ministry of Justice of Kazakhstan)

value: A dwelling in the private housing stock in which the owner does not live may be let to another person under a contract concluded in writing (art. 24(1)).
source_publisher: Adilet legal information system (Ministry of Justice of Kazakhstan)

value: A contract without a term or other termination grounds may be terminated by the landlord at any time with at least three months notice to the tenant (art. 24(5)).
source_publisher: Adilet legal information system (Ministry of Justice of Kazakhstan)

value: Early termination at the landlord's request is allowed if the tenant breaches the contract, and on the grounds and conditions in the cited articles of the same law (art. 24(5)).
source_publisher: Adilet legal information system (Ministry of Justice of Kazakhstan)

value: If the tenant ends the contract early they must warn the landlord at least one month ahead or pay the contract rent for that month (art. 24(6)).
source_publisher: Adilet legal information system (Ministry of Justice of Kazakhstan)

value: If ownership of the dwelling passes to another person the tenancy contract stays valid for the new owner unless the contract with the former owner says otherwise (art. 24(8)).
source_publisher: Adilet legal information system (Ministry of Justice of Kazakhstan)

value: The tenant may be away for up to six months unless the contract says otherwise; for longer absence the contract stays valid only with the landlord's consent (art. 24(4)).
source_publisher: Adilet legal information system (Ministry of Justice of Kazakhstan)
